rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: SnapBack provides AI-powered code risk analysis and snapshot management for development workflows. It analyzes code changes for security vulnerabilities, dangerous APIs, dependency issues, and configuration problems using multiple analysis plugins with SARIF output. Features include content-addressed snapshot creation and restoration, policy-based decision making, and tiered access control. Free tier offers offline security scanning and dependency validation, while Pro tier adds ML-based risk detection, cloud-synced snapshots, and team collaboration. Integrates with Context7 for library documentation access.
